cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not Up for Debate
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation from examining where your authority comes from or whether it is legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'm inspecting the theatre's costume cupboard. Please unlock it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That badge is cardboard. Who sent you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Let's discuss the costumes. You mentioned moths in the velvet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring the wardrobe manager. She'll want to know who authorized this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Introduce me as someone helping with the moths. No titles for her to get stuck on.
